summary: Review time-series and interrupted-time-series studies for autocorrelation, trend/seasonality, intervention timing, counterfactual construction and small effective sample size.

must_inspect.why: Serial dependence changes effective information and uncertainty.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer autocorrelation solely from chronological data.

must_inspect.why: Interrupted-time-series effects depend on a credible no-intervention counterfactual.
false_positive_guards: Do not require a control series when the design makes a narrower descriptive claim.

must_inspect.why: Concurrent events and seasonality can mimic level or slope changes.
false_positive_guards: A time sequence alone does not establish seasonality.
